sql:
select  
  region_1.r_comment, 
  orders_1.o_totalprice, 
  partsupp_1.ps_availqty, 
  partsupp_1.ps_suppkey, 
  min(
    orders_1.o_orderdate), 
  partsupp_1.ps_comment, 
  count(
    partsupp_1.ps_comment)
from 
  region as region_1
      inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
      on (region_1.r_regionkey = partsupp_1.ps_partkey )
    inner join orders as orders_1
    on (region_1.r_regionkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
where orders_1.o_orderdate >= orders_1.o_orderdate
group by orders_1.o_totalprice, partsupp_1.ps_availqty, partsupp_1.ps_comment, partsupp_1.ps_suppkey, region_1.r_comment;
nl: What are the comments for each region, total prices of orders, available quantities and supplier keys for parts, earliest order dates, comments for each part supply, and counts of comments for each part supply, grouped by total price, available quantity, comment, supplier key, and region comment?

sql:
select  
  region_1.r_regionkey, 
  supplier_1.s_suppkey, 
  region_2.r_name, 
  lineitem_1.l_tax
from 
  lineitem as lineitem_1
      inner join lineitem as lineitem_2
        inner join region as region_1
          inner join part as part_1
            inner join customer as customer_1
            on (part_1.p_partkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
          on (region_1.r_regionkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
        on (lineitem_2.l_orderkey = part_1.p_partkey )
      on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = lineitem_2.l_orderkey )
    inner join region as region_2
      inner join supplier as supplier_1
        inner join orders as orders_1
        on (supplier_1.s_suppkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
      on (region_2.r_regionkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
    on (lineitem_2.l_orderkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
where part_1.p_container is not NULL;
nl: What are the region keys, supplier keys, region names, and tax values for line items where the corresponding parts have non-null containers?

sql:
select  
  region_2.r_comment, 
  supplier_2.s_phone, 
  min(
    supplier_3.s_suppkey), 
  region_1.r_regionkey, 
  supplier_2.s_nationkey, 
  region_2.r_regionkey, 
  min(
    lineitem_1.l_partkey), 
  lineitem_1.l_receiptdate, 
  nation_1.n_comment, 
  region_2.r_name, 
  supplier_1.s_suppkey, 
  lineitem_1.l_extendedprice, 
  supplier_3.s_phone, 
  max(
    lineitem_1.l_receiptdate), 
  lineitem_1.l_discount
from 
  supplier as supplier_1
        inner join nation as nation_1
        on (supplier_1.s_nationkey = nation_1.n_nationkey )
      inner join supplier as supplier_2
        inner join customer as customer_1
        on (supplier_2.s_suppkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
      on (supplier_1.s_suppkey = supplier_2.s_suppkey )
    inner join region as region_1
      inner join region as region_2
          inner join supplier as supplier_3
          on (region_2.r_regionkey = supplier_3.s_suppkey )
        inner join lineitem as lineitem_1
        on (supplier_3.s_suppkey = lineitem_1.l_orderkey )
      on (region_1.r_regionkey = region_2.r_regionkey )
    on (supplier_1.s_suppkey = region_2.r_regionkey )
where supplier_2.s_acctbal >= lineitem_1.l_extendedprice
group by lineitem_1.l_discount, lineitem_1.l_extendedprice, lineitem_1.l_receiptdate, nation_1.n_comment, region_1.r_regionkey, region_2.r_comment, region_2.r_name, region_2.r_regionkey, supplier_1.s_suppkey, supplier_2.s_nationkey, supplier_2.s_phone, supplier_3.s_phone;
nl: What are the combinations of region comments, supplier phone numbers, minimum supplier keys, region keys, nation keys, minimum part keys, receipt dates, nation comments, region names, supplier keys, extended prices, maximum receipt dates, and discounts for groups of line items where the supplier account balance is greater than or equal to the extended price of the line item?

sql:

  nation_1.n_comment, 
  nation_1.n_regionkey, 
  max(
    nation_1.n_regionkey)
from 
  nation as nation_1
where nation_1.n_regionkey = nation_1.n_nationkey
group by nation_1.n_comment, nation_1.n_name, nation_1.n_regionkey;
nl: What are the names, comments, and region keys of nations along with the maximum region key for each group of nations that have the same comment, name, and region key as their nation key?

sql:
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_extendedprice, 
    lineitem_2.l_returnflag, 
    nation_1.n_nationkey, 
    nation_1.n_regionkey
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
      inner join lineitem as lineitem_2
        inner join nation as nation_1
        on (lineitem_2.l_orderkey = nation_1.n_nationkey )
      on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = nation_1.n_nationkey )
  where lineitem_2.l_orderkey is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_extendedprice, 
    lineitem_2.l_returnflag, 
    nation_1.n_nationkey, 
    nation_1.n_regionkey
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
      inner join lineitem as lineitem_2
        inner join nation as nation_1
        on (lineitem_2.l_orderkey = nation_1.n_nationkey )
      on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = nation_1.n_nationkey )
  where nation_1.n_regionkey > lineitem_2.l_partkey
  );
nl: What are the combinations of extended price, return flag, nation key, and region key that satisfy the condition where order key is not null but do not satisfy the condition where region key is greater than part key?

sql:
(select  
    customer_1.c_custkey, 
    customer_1.c_phone, 
    customer_1.c_acctbal, 
    nation_1.n_regionkey, 
    orders_1.o_orderdate, 
    orders_1.o_orderstatus, 
    customer_1.c_address, 
    nation_1.n_name, 
    orders_1.o_custkey, 
    nation_1.n_nationkey, 
    customer_1.c_name
  from 
    nation as nation_1
      inner join orders as orders_1
        inner join customer as customer_1
        on (orders_1.o_custkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
      on (nation_1.n_nationkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
  where customer_1.c_acctbal <= orders_1.o_totalprice
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    customer_1.c_custkey, 
    customer_1.c_phone, 
    customer_1.c_acctbal, 
    nation_1.n_regionkey, 
    orders_1.o_orderdate, 
    orders_1.o_orderstatus, 
    customer_1.c_address, 
    nation_1.n_name, 
    orders_1.o_custkey, 
    nation_1.n_nationkey, 
    customer_1.c_name
  from 
    nation as nation_1
      inner join orders as orders_1
        inner join customer as customer_1
        on (orders_1.o_custkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
      on (nation_1.n_nationkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
  where customer_1.c_address is not NULL
  );
nl: What are the customer and order details where the customer account balance is less than or equal to the total price of the order, excluding those where the customer address is not null?

            inner join nation as nation_2

        on (orders_1.o_orderkey = region_1.r_regionkey )
      inner join orders as orders_2
        inner join nation as nation_1
            inner join nation as nation_2

          inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
            inner join partsupp as partsupp_2

sql:

    region_1.r_name, 
    nation_1.n_regionkey, 
    supplier_1.s_comment, 
    nation_3.n_comment, 
    part_1.p_brand, 
    part_1.p_type, 
    supplier_1.s_address, 
    nation_1.n_comment, 
    supplier_1.s_name
  from 
    nation as nation_1
          inner join region as region_1
          on (nation_1.n_regionkey = region_1.r_regionkey )
        inner join nation as nation_2
          inner join nation as nation_3
          on (nation_2.n_nationkey = nation_3.n_nationkey )
        on (nation_1.n_nationkey = nation_3.n_nationkey )
      inner join supplier as supplier_1
        inner join part as part_1
        on (supplier_1.s_suppkey = part_1.p_partkey )
      on (nation_3.n_nationkey = part_1.p_partkey )
  where supplier_1.s_suppkey is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    nation_2.n_name, 
    region_1.r_name, 
    nation_1.n_regionkey, 
    supplier_1.s_comment, 
    nation_3.n_comment, 
    part_1.p_brand, 
    part_1.p_type, 
    supplier_1.s_address, 
    nation_1.n_comment, 
    supplier_1.s_name
  from 
    nation as nation_1
          inner join region as region_1
          on (nation_1.n_regionkey = region_1.r_regionkey )
        inner join nation as nation_2
          inner join nation as nation_3
          on (nation_2.n_nationkey = nation_3.n_nationkey )
        on (nation_1.n_nationkey = nation_3.n_nationkey )
      inner join supplier as supplier_1
        inner join part as part_1
        on (supplier_1.s_suppkey = part_1.p_partkey )
      on (nation_3.n_nationkey = part_1.p_partkey )

sql:
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_commitdate, 
    lineitem_1.l_receiptdate, 
    partsupp_1.ps_supplycost, 
    lineitem_2.l_returnflag
  from 
    partsupp as partsupp_1
      inner join supplier as supplier_1
          inner join lineitem as lineitem_1
          on (supplier_1.s_suppkey = lineitem_1.l_orderkey )
        inner join lineitem as lineitem_2
        on (supplier_1.s_suppkey = lineitem_2.l_orderkey )
      on (lineitem_2.l_suppkey = partsupp_1.ps_suppkey )
  where lineitem_1.l_linenumber < lineitem_1.l_partkey
  )
UNION
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_commitdate, 
    lineitem_1.l_receiptdate, 
    partsupp_1.ps_supplycost, 
    lineitem_2.l_returnflag
  from 
    partsupp as partsupp_1
      inner join supplier as supplier_1
          inner join lineitem as lineitem_1
          on (supplier_1.s_suppkey = lineitem_1.l_orderkey )
        inner join lineitem as lineitem_2
        on (supplier_1.s_suppkey = lineitem_2.l_orderkey )
      on (lineitem_2.l_suppkey = partsupp_1.ps_suppkey )
  where supplier_1.s_comment is not NULL
  );
nl: What are the distinct commit dates, receipt dates, supply costs, and return flags for orders where either the line number is less than the part key or the supplier comment is not null?

sql:
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_shipdate, 
    lineitem_1.l_suppkey, 
    customer_1.c_nationkey, 
    orders_1.o_orderpriority, 
    orders_1.o_custkey, 
    region_1.r_name, 
    customer_1.c_custkey, 
    region_1.r_regionkey, 
    customer_1.c_name, 
    lineitem_1.l_extendedprice, 
    lineitem_1.l_tax
  from 
    orders as orders_1
        inner join lineitem as lineitem_1
        on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
      inner join region as region_1
        inner join customer as customer_1
        on (region_1.r_regionkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
      on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = region_1.r_regionkey )
  where orders_1.o_orderkey < lineitem_1.l_suppkey
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_shipdate, 
    lineitem_1.l_suppkey, 
    customer_1.c_nationkey, 
    orders_1.o_orderpriority, 
    orders_1.o_custkey, 
    region_1.r_name, 
    customer_1.c_custkey, 
    region_1.r_regionkey, 
    customer_1.c_name, 
    lineitem_1.l_extendedprice, 
    lineitem_1.l_tax
  from 
    orders as orders_1
        inner join lineitem as lineitem_1
        on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
      inner join region as region_1
        inner join customer as customer_1
        on (region_1.r_regionkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
      on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = region_1.r_regionkey )
  where lineitem_1.l_discount is not NULL
  );

sql:
select  
  count(
    supplier_1.s_address), 
  avg(
    region_1.r_regionkey), 
  partsupp_1.ps_availqty, 
  min(
    partsupp_1.ps_supplycost), 
  avg(
    partsupp_1.ps_supplycost), 
  region_1.r_comment, 
  partsupp_1.ps_supplycost, 
  supplier_1.s_address, 
  partsupp_1.ps_suppkey, 
  region_1.r_name, 
  region_1.r_regionkey, 
  max(
    partsupp_1.ps_partkey)
from 
  partsupp as partsupp_1
    inner join supplier as supplier_1
      inner join region as region_1
      on (supplier_1.s_suppkey = region_1.r_regionkey )
    on (partsupp_1.ps_suppkey = supplier_1.s_suppkey )
where supplier_1.s_address is not NULL
group by partsupp_1.ps_availqty, partsupp_1.ps_suppkey, partsupp_1.ps_supplycost, region_1.r_comment, region_1.r_name, region_1.r_regionkey, supplier_1.s_address;
nl: What are the counts of addresses, averages and minimums of certain costs, availability quantities, and comments for groups of suppliers and regions with non-null addresses?

    nation_1.n_regionkey), 
  count(
    nation_1.n_name)
from 
  nation as nation_1
where nation_1.n_name <= nation_1.n_name
group by nation_1.n_comment, nation_1.n_name, nation_1.n_nationkey, nation_1.n_regionkey;
nl: What are the comment, name, maximum region key, nation key, region key, total count, minimum nation key, average region key, and count of names for each group of nations with the same comment, name, nation key, and region key where the name is less than or equal to itself?

sql:
(select  
    region_1.r_comment, 
    region_1.r_regionkey
  from 
    region as region_1
  where region_1.r_name = region_1.r_name
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    region_1.r_comment, 
    region_1.r_regionkey
  from 
    region as region_1
  where region_1.r_regionkey <= region_1.r_regionkey
  );
nl: What regions have a comment and key where the name is the same as itself but excluding those where the region key is less than or equal to itself

sql:
select  
  orders_1.o_orderpriority, 
  orders_1.o_orderkey, 
  max(
    orders_1.o_custkey), 
  orders_1.o_orderdate, 
  orders_1.o_shippriority, 
  orders_1.o_clerk
from 
  orders as orders_1
where orders_1.o_shippriority is not NULL
group by orders_1.o_clerk, orders_1.o_orderdate, orders_1.o_orderkey, orders_1.o_orderpriority, orders_1.o_shippriority;
nl: What are the order priority, order key, maximum customer key, order date, shipping priority, and clerk for each group of orders with the same clerk, order date, order key, order priority, and shipping priority, where a shipping priority is specified?

sql:
(select  
    orders_1.o_orderpriority, 
    orders_1.o_shippriority, 
    part_1.p_mfgr, 
    part_1.p_brand, 
    part_1.p_comment, 
    orders_1.o_orderkey, 
    orders_1.o_comment
  from 
    orders as orders_1
      inner join part as part_1
      on (orders_1.o_orderkey = part_1.p_partkey )
  where part_1.p_name is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    orders_1.o_orderpriority, 
    orders_1.o_shippriority, 
    part_1.p_mfgr, 
    part_1.p_brand, 
    part_1.p_comment, 
    orders_1.o_orderkey, 
    orders_1.o_comment
  from 
    orders as orders_1
      inner join part as part_1
      on (orders_1.o_orderkey = part_1.p_partkey )
  where orders_1.o_custkey < orders_1.o_orderkey
  );
nl: What are the order priority, ship priority, manufacturer, brand, comment, order key, and order comments for parts with a non-null name, excluding those where the customer key is less than the order key?

sql:
(select  
    partsupp_1.ps_suppkey, 
    orders_1.o_totalprice, 
    partsupp_1.ps_comment, 
    partsupp_1.ps_availqty
  from 
    orders as orders_1
      inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
      on (orders_1.o_orderkey = partsupp_1.ps_partkey )
  where partsupp_1.ps_availqty is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    partsupp_1.ps_suppkey, 
    orders_1.o_totalprice, 
    partsupp_1.ps_comment, 
    partsupp_1.ps_availqty
  from 
    orders as orders_1
      inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
      on (orders_1.o_orderkey = partsupp_1.ps_partkey )
  where orders_1.o_totalprice is not NULL
  );
nl: What are the distinct supplier keys, order total prices, comments, and available quantities for orders where either the available quantity or the order total price is known?

sql:
(select  
    region_1.r_name, 
    region_1.r_regionkey, 
    region_1.r_comment, 
    partsupp_1.ps_availqty, 
    customer_1.c_comment, 
    partsupp_1.ps_comment
  from 
    partsupp as partsupp_1
        inner join region as region_1
        on (partsupp_1.ps_partkey = region_1.r_regionkey )
      inner join customer as customer_1
      on (region_1.r_regionkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
  where customer_1.c_custkey is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    region_1.r_name, 
    region_1.r_regionkey, 
    region_1.r_comment, 
    partsupp_1.ps_availqty, 
    customer_1.c_comment, 
    partsupp_1.ps_comment
  from 
    partsupp as partsupp_1
        inner join region as region_1
        on (partsupp_1.ps_partkey = region_1.r_regionkey )
      inner join customer as customer_1
      on (region_1.r_regionkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
  where partsupp_1.ps_partkey is not NULL
  );
nl: What are the distinct region names, region keys, region comments, available quantities, customer comments, and part supply comments for customers with a valid customer key or parts with a valid part key?

sql:
(select  
    nation_1.n_name
  from 
    region as region_1
      inner join nation as nation_1
      on (nation_1.n_regionkey = region_1.r_regionkey )
  where region_1.r_comment is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    nation_1.n_name
  from 
    region as region_1
      inner join nation as nation_1
      on (nation_1.n_regionkey = region_1.r_regionkey )
  where nation_1.n_nationkey is not NULL
  );
nl: What are the names of nations in regions with a comment excluding those that have a nation key?

sql:
(select  
    part_1.p_comment, 
    part_1.p_type
  from 
    part as part_1
  where part_1.p_comment is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    part_1.p_comment, 
    part_1.p_type
  from 
    part as part_1
  where part_1.p_retailprice > part_1.p_retailprice
  );
nl: What are the distinct comments and types of parts that either have a comment or have a retail price greater than themselves?

sql:
select  
  min(
    orders_1.o_custkey), 
  customer_1.c_address
from 
  orders as orders_1
    inner join customer as customer_1
    on (orders_1.o_custkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
where orders_1.o_orderdate is not NULL
group by customer_1.c_address;
nl: What is the minimum customer key and address for each customer address where there are orders with a non-null order date?

sql:
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_quantity, 
    nation_1.n_regionkey, 
    lineitem_1.l_shipmode, 
    nation_1.n_nationkey, 
    customer_1.c_mktsegment, 
    lineitem_1.l_partkey, 
    nation_1.n_comment, 
    nation_1.n_name
  from 
    nation as nation_1
        inner join lineitem as lineitem_1
        on (nation_1.n_nationkey = lineitem_1.l_orderkey )
      inner join customer as customer_1
      on (customer_1.c_nationkey = nation_1.n_nationkey )
  where lineitem_1.l_shipmode is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_quantity, 
    nation_1.n_regionkey, 
    lineitem_1.l_shipmode, 
    nation_1.n_nationkey, 
    customer_1.c_mktsegment, 
    lineitem_1.l_partkey, 
    nation_1.n_comment, 
    nation_1.n_name
  from 
    nation as nation_1
        inner join lineitem as lineitem_1
        on (nation_1.n_nationkey = lineitem_1.l_orderkey )
      inner join customer as customer_1
      on (customer_1.c_nationkey = nation_1.n_nationkey )
  where lineitem_1.l_receiptdate > lineitem_1.l_commitdate
  );
nl: What are the distinct quantity, region key, ship mode, nation key, market segment, part key, comment, and name for orders where the ship mode is not unknown or the receipt date is later than the commit date?

sql:
(select  
    supplier_1.s_phone, 
    supplier_1.s_suppkey
  from 
    supplier as supplier_1
  where supplier_1.s_comment is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    supplier_1.s_phone, 
    supplier_1.s_suppkey
  from 
    supplier as supplier_1
  where supplier_1.s_acctbal > supplier_1.s_acctbal
  );
nl: What are the distinct phone numbers and supplier keys for suppliers that either have a comment or have an account balance greater than their own account balance

sql:
select  
  supplier_1.s_nationkey, 
  orders_1.o_custkey, 
  supplier_1.s_address, 
  supplier_1.s_suppkey, 
  sum(
    orders_1.o_shippriority), 
  avg(
    orders_1.o_totalprice), 
  supplier_1.s_comment, 
  max(
    orders_1.o_orderdate)
from 
  customer as customer_1
      inner join orders as orders_1
      on (orders_1.o_custkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
    inner join supplier as supplier_1
    on (customer_1.c_custkey = supplier_1.s_suppkey )
where customer_1.c_address is not NULL
group by orders_1.o_custkey, supplier_1.s_address, supplier_1.s_comment, supplier_1.s_nationkey, supplier_1.s_suppkey;
nl: What are the nation key, customer key, address, supplier key, total shipping priority, average total price, comment, and latest order date for each group of customers and suppliers where the customer address is not null?

sql:
(select  
    region_3.r_regionkey, 
    orders_1.o_custkey, 
    region_3.r_comment, 
    orders_1.o_shippriority, 
    region_1.r_regionkey
  from 
    region as region_1
        inner join region as region_2
          inner join orders as orders_1
          on (region_2.r_regionkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
        on (region_1.r_regionkey = region_2.r_regionkey )
      inner join region as region_3
      on (orders_1.o_orderkey = region_3.r_regionkey )
  where region_2.r_comment is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    region_3.r_regionkey, 
    orders_1.o_custkey, 
    region_3.r_comment, 
    orders_1.o_shippriority, 
    region_1.r_regionkey
  from 
    region as region_1
        inner join region as region_2
          inner join orders as orders_1
          on (region_2.r_regionkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
        on (region_1.r_regionkey = region_2.r_regionkey )
      inner join region as region_3
      on (orders_1.o_orderkey = region_3.r_regionkey )
  where region_2.r_regionkey is not NULL
  );
nl: What are the distinct records that include region key, customer key, comment, ship priority, and another region key from orders and regions where either the comment or the region key of one of the regions is not null?

sql:
select  
  lineitem_1.l_shipdate, 
  lineitem_1.l_quantity
from 
  lineitem as lineitem_1
where lineitem_1.l_shipdate <= lineitem_1.l_receiptdate;
nl: What are the ship dates and quantities for orders where the ship date is on or before the receipt date?

sql:
select  
  customer_1.c_comment, 
  min(
    customer_1.c_nationkey)
from 
  customer as customer_1
where customer_1.c_nationkey is not NULL
group by customer_1.c_comment;
nl: What are the comments and minimum nation keys for each group of customers with a non-null nation key?

sql:
select  
  count(*), 
  min(
    nation_1.n_regionkey), 
  nation_2.n_regionkey, 
  nation_1.n_comment
from 
  nation as nation_1
    inner join nation as nation_2
    on (nation_1.n_nationkey = nation_2.n_nationkey )
where nation_1.n_name = nation_2.n_name
group by nation_1.n_comment, nation_2.n_regionkey;
nl: What are the counts and minimum region keys for groups of nations with matching names, grouped by their comments and region keys?

sql:
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_quantity, 
    lineitem_1.l_returnflag, 
    lineitem_1.l_orderkey, 
    lineitem_1.l_tax, 
    lineitem_1.l_commitdate
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
  where lineitem_1.l_linenumber is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_quantity, 
    lineitem_1.l_returnflag, 
    lineitem_1.l_orderkey, 
    lineitem_1.l_tax, 
    lineitem_1.l_commitdate
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
  where lineitem_1.l_receiptdate is not NULL
  );
nl: What are the distinct quantity, return flag, order key, tax, and commit date for orders where either the line number or receipt date is not null?

sql:
(select  
    orders_1.o_custkey, 
    supplier_1.s_address, 
    lineitem_1.l_orderkey, 
    orders_1.o_orderpriority, 
    lineitem_1.l_discount, 
    lineitem_1.l_shipdate
  from 
    orders as orders_1
      inner join nation as nation_1
          inner join customer as customer_1
            inner join supplier as supplier_1
            on (customer_1.c_custkey = supplier_1.s_suppkey )
          on (supplier_1.s_nationkey = nation_1.n_nationkey )
        inner join lineitem as lineitem_1
        on (customer_1.c_custkey = lineitem_1.l_orderkey )
      on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
  where nation_1.n_name is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    orders_1.o_custkey, 
    supplier_1.s_address, 
    lineitem_1.l_orderkey, 
    orders_1.o_orderpriority, 
    lineitem_1.l_discount, 
    lineitem_1.l_shipdate
  from 
    orders as orders_1
      inner join nation as nation_1
          inner join customer as customer_1
            inner join supplier as supplier_1
            on (customer_1.c_custkey = supplier_1.s_suppkey )
          on (supplier_1.s_nationkey = nation_1.n_nationkey )
        inner join lineitem as lineitem_1
        on (customer_1.c_custkey = lineitem_1.l_orderkey )
      on (lineitem_1.l_orderkey = orders_1.o_orderkey )
  where customer_1.c_acctbal <= supplier_1.s_acctbal
  );
nl: What are the distinct records for customer key, supplier address, order key, order priority, discount, and ship date where either the nation name is not null or the customer account balance is less than or equal to the supplier account balance?

sql:
select  
  customer_1.c_mktsegment, 
  min(
    customer_1.c_custkey), 
  customer_1.c_phone, 
  region_1.r_regionkey, 
  partsupp_1.ps_availqty, 
  lineitem_1.l_orderkey
from 
  region as region_1
      inner join lineitem as lineitem_1
      on (region_1.r_regionkey = lineitem_1.l_orderkey )
    inner join partsupp as partsupp_1
      inner join customer as customer_1
      on (partsupp_1.ps_partkey = customer_1.c_custkey )
    on (lineitem_1.l_suppkey = partsupp_1.ps_partkey )
where partsupp_1.ps_suppkey is not NULL
group by customer_1.c_mktsegment, customer_1.c_phone, lineitem_1.l_orderkey, partsupp_1.ps_availqty, region_1.r_regionkey;
nl: What are the market segments and phone numbers of customers along with their corresponding minimum customer keys, available quantities, order keys, and region keys for each group of customers with the same market segment, phone number, order key, available quantity, and region key, where the supplier key is not null?

sql:
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_orderkey, 
    lineitem_1.l_commitdate, 
    lineitem_1.l_linenumber
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
  where lineitem_1.l_quantity is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    lineitem_1.l_orderkey, 
    lineitem_1.l_commitdate, 
    lineitem_1.l_linenumber
  from 
    lineitem as lineitem_1
  where lineitem_1.l_commitdate is not NULL
  );
nl: What are the order key, commit date, and line number for records where quantity is not null but commit date is null?
